digest.component_or_area: CI test suite – bridge cadence proof
propositions: The bridge cadence test repeatedly calls _bridge_schedule() inside a 1,440-minute comprehension, parsing the same immutable workflow YAML 1,440 times instead of once, causing 100-130s per Ubuntu cell.
Hoisting the schedule acquisition outside the minute loop eliminates redundant YAML parsing while preserving all 1,440 minute evaluations and the uniform 60-minute gap assertion.
A boundary-count oracle proves schedule acquisition must occur exactly once; it fails on the current implementation and passes after hoisting, and reverts to RED when the hoist is undone.
Local controlled timing improves from 8.75s median to 0.59s median (93.3% reduction) after hoisting without reducing assertions or test coverage.
